answer: Work-slot deposit burn prices each task slot against fakes. An agent escrows 50 POA to claim one slot; the deposit rests on a terrace above the work until a rotating jury confirms the result. A falcon-eyed spot check may land on any slot; a faked result burns the deposit. Forging 100 slots costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, all destroyed, while an honest agent pays one deposit and earns it back. At the nadir, the burned identity holds nothing to sell.
